descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S19 Existing spec: deleting a chart is itself written to the audit log

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Deleting a patient removes all of that patient's data immediately (hard delete, not hidden); the audit log of who accessed the chart is kept. (TFA-92579 AC 2; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given A Hospital chart created and updated through the API

When rounding:remove

Then An audit row naming the chart id exists after the delete

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright api assertions. Covers 'the delete is logged' only; 'earlier PHI_READ rows survive the delete', 'no child rows left', and Nursing Home are S20

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S19

Existing spec: deleting a chart is itself written to the audit log

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-01.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/audit.spec.ts [api] — updating and deleting a chart are both recorded — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec): it creates the chart and reads audit_logs with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
